description: Java class implementing a mock Zigbee IAS Zone cluster for testing, simulating a door/window sensor with capabilities like tamper, fault, battery, and trouble status, including event handling and attribute management.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee IAS Zone cluster simulating a door/window sensor with status attributes and event notifications.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster.ZoneType
classes.description: Enumeration of different zone types for the mock sensor, such as motion, contact switch, fire sensor, etc.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster.ZoneStatus
classes.description: Class representing the status flags of the zone, including tamper, battery low, trouble, alarm, etc.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster.ServerCommand
classes.description: Constants for server-side commands related to zone status and enrollment.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster.ClientCommand
classes.description: Constants for client-side commands for zone enrollment and mode initiation.

methods.name: getZoneStatus
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current zone status flags based on internal state.

methods.name: onZoneStatusChanged
methods.description: Sends a zone status change event if the device is paired.

methods.name: setFaulted
methods.description: Sets the open/faulted state of the zone and triggers status update.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered state and triggers status update.

methods.name: isFaulted
methods.description: Returns whether the zone is faulted (open).

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns whether the zone is tampered.

methods.name: isTroubled
methods.description: Returns whether the zone is troubled.

methods.name: setTroubled
methods.description: Sets the troubled state and triggers status update.

methods.name: isEnrolled
methods.description: Returns whether the zone is enrolled.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves attribute data based on attribute info, serializing internal state.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Sets attribute data based on attribute info, updating internal state.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming commands such as zone enrollment response.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Updates low battery status and triggers event.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Returns whether the battery is low.
